description: Busiest Airports by Passenger Traffic is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Airports Council International. Top 30 world's busiest airports by international passenger traffic and top 50 world's busiest airports by passenger traffic. Data are measured by total passengers (data from Airports Council International (ACI), defined as passengers enplaned plus passengers deplaned plus direct-transit passengers. Coverage: Airports Council International. The publisher named on the listing is Airports Council International. Its keywords include passengers, visitors, airports, flights, planes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
